description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultWebsocketConfig class in the Eclipse Ditto project, verifying configuration immutability, equality, default values, actual configuration values, and rendering correctness.

classes.name: DefaultWebsocketConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultWebsocketConfig, verifying configuration defaults, values, immutability, equality, and rendering.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the static configuration used in tests by loading 'websocket-test' config.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DefaultWebsocketConfig instances are immutable and that ThrottlingConfig is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode implementation of DefaultWebsocketConfig.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesIfBaseConfigWasEmpty
methods.description: Checks that default configuration values are returned when an empty config is supplied.

methods.name: underTestReturnsValuesOfConfigFile
methods.description: Verifies that configuration values are correctly read from the provided config file.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Tests rendering of configuration to a Config object and reconstructing from it.
